title: Check: Area of Rectangles and Triangles

questions.stem: What is the area of a rectangle with length $12\text{ cm}$ and width $7\text{ cm}$?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle $= l \times w = 12 \times 7 = 84\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: A triangle has a base of $10\text{ cm}$ and a perpendicular height of $6\text{ cm}$. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle $= \frac{1}{2} \times b \times h = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 6 = 30\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: Which measurement must be used as the height when calculating the area of a triangle?

options.text: The longest side of the triangle
The perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite vertex
The slant height along a side

questions.explanation: The height in the area formula $\frac{1}{2}bh$ must be the perpendicular distance from the chosen base to the opposite vertex, not a slant side.
